description: Cumulative local-recurrence probability (Kaplan-Meier-style step curves) in a SAS-style closed frame: four series, blue and red, each solid (unweighted) and dashed (weighted), with censor ticks. Journal figure (Ikawa et al. 2022, BMC Cancer 22:301, Fig. 1 panel a; crop x 3-970, y 2-727 of the publisher's 1944x731 PNG, inside the panel's light-grey border), 967x725 PNG. Hand-labelled by pixel analysis (Pillow): positions are image pixels, origin top-left, integer = pixel centre, +/- ~1 px. Provenance and licence: fixtures/real/PROVENANCE.md.

xAxis.notes: axisLineRow is the bottom frame line (grey ~170, 2 px), which carries the tick marks; the value 0 is not at the left frame edge. Tick marks point outward below the frame (rows 577-586, 1-2 px wide); labels 0, 12, ..., 84 centred within 0.6 px of the marks.

yAxis.notes: axisLineCol is the left frame line (grey ~170, 2 px), which carries the tick marks; the value 0 is 11.5 px above the bottom frame line. Tick marks point outward left of the frame (columns 177-186); labels 0.0-1.0 every 0.1.

knownValues.description: Blue dashed, final plateau (dashes from column 470 to 941; dash ~6 px, gap ~6 px); 4 px below the blue solid plateau
Blue dashed, plateau ~10-20.6 months (dashes at columns 302-389); 8 px below the blue solid plateau
Red dashed, final plateau (dashes from column 470 to 944); 19 px above the red solid plateau

pitfalls: The plot is a closed box frame of light-grey lines; the frame lines are NOT the axes (x = 0 is 28 px inside the left frame line, y = 0 is 11.5 px above the bottom one).

A number-at-risk table (High dose 68 60 55 51 47 41 37 33 / Standard dose 66 52 40 33 26 20 10 6) sits BELOW the x-axis title (rows ~663-706), its numbers aligned under the x tick labels, with row labels left of the frame - easy to take for tick labels.

A four-entry legend with line samples (rows 69-73 blue, 91-94 red, columns 197-273) and two log-rank-test lines of text sit inside the frame (top left / top right); the panel title 'Local recurrence' sits above it.

Same-colour pairs told apart only by style: the blue dashed plateau runs 4 px below the blue solid one (0.096 vs 0.105), the red dashed 19 px above the red solid; the dashed series start together with the solid ones near the origin and cross them at the steps.
'+' censor ticks of the series' own colour stand on the solid curves (they are not steps); the line width is 3 px.
